message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"Only the phase_bits=16 linear LUT configuration meets the 8-LSB quality target, but it costs 1584.6 um^2. The nearest-neighbor and larger-depth alternatives are cheaper but still fail quality, while CORDIC is much larger. Decreasing precision is the only available action that can reduce area from the current high-precision LUT family, and it has a legal unvisited neighbor to explore a lower-area point near the quality boundary."}
